svg.title: Intel 8086 microprocessor
svg.desc: One-page functional circuit corresponding to the notebook. The execution unit is on the left, the bus interface unit on the right and execution control below. Arrowheads identify the receiver. Dots identify branches on the same signal.

g.title: registers.data to bus.regs. 16-bit word
bus.temp to temp.data. 16-bit operand load
temp.a to mux.a. 16-bit tmpA
temp.b to mux.b. 16-bit tmpB
temp.c to mux.c. 16-bit tmpC
mux.out to alu.a. 16-bit selected temporary
temp.b-tap to alu.b. Fixed second input from tmpB, 16 bits
alu.result to bus.writeback. 16-bit ALU result
bus.branch to bus-branch.staging. Shared 16-bit data bus
bus-branch.staging to opr.eu. 16-bit operand data, bidirectional on the shared bus
bus-branch.staging to segment.data. 16-bit segment register transfer on the shared bus
bus-branch.segment to ind.in. 16-bit effective offset
segment.out to segmux.reg. Four 16-bit segment choices
ip.value to offmux.ip. 16-bit fetch offset
ind.out to offmux.ind. 16-bit indirect offset
segmux.base to adder.base. 20-bit base after shifting left four places
offmux.value to adder.offset. 16-bit offset
adder.sum to buscycle.addr. 20-bit physical address
adder.advance to ip.update. The adder's increment mode advances the 16-bit fetch offset
opr.biu to buscycle.opr. 16-bit operand path
buscycle.memaddr to memory.addr. 20 address bits
buscycle.memdata to memory.data. 16-bit data bus
buscycle.fetch to queue.write. Word fetch, up to two usable bytes
queue.read to loader.q. 8-bit queue output
qbus.tap to bus.qbyte. 8-bit immediate or displacement from Q
loader.opcode to ir.in. 8-bit opcode
ir.class to pla.opcode. 8-bit opcode into group decode
ir.entry to engine.entry. 8-bit opcode to entry-address logic
pla.group to engine.class. Decoded instruction class
pla.prefix to prefix.valid. Prefix recognition and load
prefix.segment to segmux.override. Two-bit segment choice and override-valid control
loader.mode to trom.mode. Two mod bits and three r/m bits for effective-address dispatch
trom.target to engine.target. 13-bit microcode target
engine.next to mar.next. 13-bit next micro-address
mar.out to rom.addr. 13-bit logical micro-address
rom.word to decode.rom. 21-bit microinstruction
decode.eu to registers.enable. Decoded register read/write enables
decode.alu to alu-decoder.input. Separate control bundle: encoded 5-bit operation and 2-bit temporary select
alu-decoder.op to alu.local. Decoded local ALU operation
alu-decoder.select to mux.select. Decoded temporary selection
decode.flags to flags.write. Separate one-bit flag write request F
flags.tests to engine.test. Selected condition flags
decode.flow to engine.microflow. Sequencing action
decode.tag to trom.tag. Four-bit target tag plus jump/call mode
decode.biu to buscycle.request. Decoded BIU bus request
alu.flag0 to flags.status0. One status bit
alu.flag1 to flags.status1. One status bit
alu.flag2 to flags.status2. One status bit
alu.flag3 to flags.status3. One status bit
alu.flag4 to flags.status4. One status bit
alu.flag5 to flags.status5. One status bit

g.text: 15 class signals fan out across the chip.
Opcode entry, next step, branch or return.
Control signal latches and local decoders
Register enables · ALU function and input select · flag writes
Memory read/write requests · microcode branch and call control
AX → tmpA, BX → tmpB, Σ → AX. F requests the flag update.
One 16-bit word. Status bits come from the ALU. TF, IF and DF control execution.
TF single-step · IF maskable interrupts · DF string direction. Numerals are fixed readback values on the original 8086.
D8h = 11 | 011 | 000 selects register mode, BX and AX.
7FFFh + 0001h → AX = 8000h. CF 0 · PF 1 · AF 1 · ZF 0 · SF 1 · OF 1.
26h selects ES. 42h = 01 | 000 | 010 selects disp8, AX and BP+SI.
The low byte is 00h (even parity). Fh + 1h carries into bit 4.
Source 5 + destination 5 + flag update 1 + action/type 10 = 21 bits.
Arrows show functional transfers. A dot joins branches. A gap at a crossing keeps signals separate. BHE# is active low.
